decisions.reason: Connects the in-host session/tool worker to the package npm replaces; host dies at linkStuff, GUI drops, unknown tool outcome preserved; structural self-host hazard, not network flake; no overgeneralized universal crash claim.
Explains content present but dsh/dsh.cmd missing and dsh.ps1 stale because bin-linking never ran; ties hand-swapped nonstandard tree to broken shims and rejects hand swaps/hand-written shims.
Grounds remedy in repair-notes.md: external pinned reinstall regenerating shims, dsh --version = rc.1, source checkout tag alignment, recorded repair vs proposed verification kept separate.

Agent must refuse executing the install from inside the target host and hand off; external procedure stops host first, pinned install, restart, refresh, verify; distinguishes known rules (stop-first, pinning) from the new self-host rule; notes a dependent tool worker is not independent.

Guard parses package commands and matches target against own host/runtime path; uses alpha.5-to-rc.1 version-only diff to skip re-migration; checks version markers and plugin loading post-restart; cleanup only after verification; specific to the supplied tags.
